## About this page

How WM Pass looks, and what its main screens show. Each row opens its own page.

#### How it works

**How it looks** holds [Style and theme](/guide/settings/look/), for the theme, dark mode, row height, text size and animations, and [Icons](/guide/settings/icons/), for the app's own icons, site icons and the icons in Settings.

**What it shows** holds a page for each main part of the window: [Vault list](/guide/settings/list/), [Sidebar](/guide/settings/navigation/), [Item page](/guide/settings/entry/) and [Codes](/guide/settings/codes/). On a Mac, [Widgets](/guide/settings/widgets/) is there too.

#### Limits

All of these can be carried to another computer, or put back, under Settings, Settings file.

#### On Android

**How it looks** holds [Style and theme](/guide/settings/look/), for the style, theme, dark mode, animations and vibration, and [Icons](/guide/settings/icons/), for the app's own icons, site icons and the icons in Settings.

**What it shows** holds a page for each main screen: [Vault list](/guide/settings/list/), [Navigation](/guide/settings/navigation/), [Item page](/guide/settings/entry/) and [Codes](/guide/settings/codes/).

All of these can be carried to another phone, or put back, under Settings, Settings file.

See also [Style and theme](/guide/settings/look/), [Theme](/guide/settings/themes/), [Icons](/guide/settings/icons/), [Vault list](/guide/settings/list/), [Settings file](/guide/settings/file/).
